relationships.subject: microglia in mPFC
relationships.evidence_quote: significant enhancement of phagocytosis of PSD-95-positive synaptic components by microglia

relationships.subject: minocycline
relationships.evidence_quote: local injection of the microglia inhibitor minocycline into the mPFC markedly alleviated pain-induced anxiety-like behaviors

key_findings: CION increases mPFC microglial density and synaptic phagocytosis (MERTK, LAMP2); electroacupuncture reverses this.
